label: Ventilation Settings
definition: Mechanical ventilation parameters and settings delivered as part of baseline intensive care management.

label: Secondary Insult Detection
definition: The identification of preventable physiological derangements that worsen brain injury, detected through appropriate monitoring methods.

label: Observation Value
definition: The numeric or qualitative value produced by a sensing process for a measured parameter.

label: Glasgow Coma Scale (GCS) Assessment
definition: A standardised neurological score for consciousness level, collected as part of intensive care management information.

label: Jugular Venous Oxygen Saturation
definition: Oxygen saturation in the jugular venous blood, an additional monitoring variable indicating cerebral oxygen consumption when monitored as part of usual clinical management.

label: Intensive Care Monitoring Trial
definition: A research study designed to test new monitoring technologies or methods in the intensive care setting.

label: Intensive Care Monitoring Standard
definition: Established procedures and best practices for the collection, analysis, and reporting of intensive care monitoring data.

label: Bedside Monitoring
definition: Real-time physiological monitoring performed at the patient's bedside using networked or interfaced monitoring systems.

label: Treatment
definition: A clinical intervention administered to a patient, used to contextualise out-of-range physiological values.

label: Observation Collection
definition: A grouping of multiple observations associated with a timepoint, representing all readings taken at that moment.

label: Eye Care
definition: Routine nursing intervention for eye care, annotated as part of intensive care management information.

label: Intensive Care Monitoring Data
definition: High-resolution time-series data collected from patients in intensive care settings, including physiological parameters and clinical observations.

label: Intensive Care Unit
definition: A hospital department that provides critical care to patients with life-threatening conditions, generating large volumes of patient monitoring data.

label: Patient Outcome
definition: The clinical result or recovery status of TBI patients following treatment.

label: Patient Data
definition: Information recorded from patients in the ICU, including manually and automatically recorded measurements and observations.

label: Intensive Care Treatment Trial
definition: A research study designed to evaluate new therapeutic approaches or interventions in the intensive care setting.

label: Outcome Data
definition: Clinical measurements and assessments documenting patient recovery and functional status following treatment.

label: Brain Injury
definition: A traumatic or acquired injury to the brain requiring intensive care management and monitoring.

label: Sensor Accuracy
definition: The precision specification of a monitoring sensor, defined as a +/- value or percentage, used to adjust acceptable range validation.

label: Pharmacological Therapy Trial
definition: A clinical trial testing the efficacy of new drugs, supported by the standardized BrainIT data collection network.

label: Reduced Cerebral Perfusion Pressure
definition: Decreased cerebral perfusion pressure secondary to raised intracranial pressure, a secondary insult that may be treated with arterial pressors.

label: Medical Decision Making
definition: The clinical process in which ICU data is used to inform treatment and management decisions.

label: Arterial Oxygen Saturation
definition: Arterial oxygen saturation measured by pulse oximetry, indicating blood oxygenation levels as a core monitoring parameter.

label: Neurological Outcome
definition: The functional or neurological status of a patient following TBI management.

label: High-resolution Monitoring
definition: Frequent data sampling (less than 1 minute intervals) enabling detection of short-duration physiological events.

label: Treatment Data
definition: Information documenting therapeutic interventions and management approaches provided to patients.

label: Medical Disorder
definition: A clinical condition that may explain out-of-range physiological values when associated with characteristic symptoms.

label: Neurological Injury
definition: Previous injury to the nervous system documented in patient medical history.

label: High-Resolution Monitoring Data
definition: Detailed physiological measurements collected at frequent intervals to provide comprehensive temporal coverage.

label: Transcranial Doppler
definition: Transcranial Doppler ultrasonography, an additional monitoring variable used to assess cerebral blood flow velocity when monitored as part of usual clinical management.

label: Data Assessment
definition: The process of evaluating ICU data quality using computational frameworks that consider data, provenance, and clinical knowledge.

label: Blood Brain Barrier
definition: A physiological barrier limiting drug penetration into the brain, relevant to neuroprotective drug efficacy in brain injury.

label: Sensing Process
definition: The process by which a sensor measures and produces a value for a clinical parameter.

label: Physiological Data
definition: Time series measurements of patient physiological parameters collected from ICU monitoring equipment.

label: Head Up Tilt
definition: The angle of patient positioning that affects hydrostatic fluid column effects on pressure measurement.

label: Emergency Medical Services
definition: Pre-hospital emergency care and transport services providing initial patient assessment and care.

label: Catheter-tip Transducer
definition: A technology for measuring intracranial pressure, one of multiple standardization issues affecting ICP monitoring across centers.

label: Monitoring Channel
definition: A specific type of physiological monitoring parameter or data stream collected as part of bedside monitoring.

label: Non-Invasive Blood Pressure
definition: Non-invasive blood pressure monitoring as an optional parameter.

label: Management Data
definition: Detailed information on clinical management and treatment decisions for brain-injured patients collected as part of the standardized dataset.

label: Prospective Trial
definition: A forward-looking study to test the effectiveness of BrainIT data collection procedures and validate inter- and intra-centre performance.

label: Neuro-Monitoring Assessment
definition: The evaluation and comparison of different neuro-monitoring technologies and approaches for clinical utility.

label: Mouth Care
definition: Routine nursing intervention for mouth care, annotated as part of intensive care management information.

label: Monitoring Method
definition: The technique or approach used to continuously observe and record physiological parameters in clinical practice.

label: Brain Tissue Oxygen
definition: Partial pressure of brain tissue oxygen, an additional monitoring variable measuring local cerebral oxygenation when monitored as part of usual clinical management.

label: Substance Abuse
definition: History of substance use documented as part of patient medical background.

label: Sampling Rate
definition: The frequency at which a sensor records measurements of a parameter, specified as part of machine configuration.

label: Medical History
definition: Patient history data focused on identifying previous neurological injury, substance abuse, and associated injuries.

label: General Medical Icu
definition: A type of intensive care unit providing critical care to patients with general medical conditions.

label: Blood Brain Barrier Penetration
definition: The ability of a drug or substance to cross the blood-brain barrier and reach therapeutic concentrations in brain tissue.

label: Data Provenance
definition: Information about the origin, history, and context of ICU data, used to support data quality assessment.

label: Traumatic Brain Injury
definition: A severe head injury caused by external trauma, characterized by disruption of normal brain function and requiring intensive neurological monitoring and management.

label: Monitoring Approach
definition: A standardised method or technology for continuously observing and recording patient physiological parameters.

label: Continuous Infusion
definition: A method of drug delivery via continuous infusion pump for secondary insult therapy.

label: Neuro-intensive Care Unit
definition: A specialized intensive care unit providing high-resolution minute-by-minute physiological monitoring and management of brain-injured patients.

label: Data Summary Standards
definition: Standardized methods for aggregating and presenting collected clinical data in a consistent format.

label: Management Approach
definition: A clinical strategy or protocol for treating and caring for patients with brain injury.

label: Suctioning
definition: Nursing intervention involving removal of secretions from the airway, performed at regular intervals.

label: Central Venous Pressure
definition: The pressure in the thoracic vena cava near the right atrium, an additional monitoring variable included in the BrainIT database when monitored as part of usual clinical management.

label: Head Injury
definition: Injury to the head resulting from trauma, with serious economic, social, and health consequences including death and long-term morbidity.

label: Hydrostatic Pressure Gradient
definition: The pressure difference between the head and heart affected by bed tilt, a technical factor requiring standardized measurement in CPP monitoring.

label: Main Lesion
definition: The primary intracranial lesion identified on CT scan, classified as none, subdural, extradural, or intraparenchymal.

label: Sex
definition: Patient biological sex, a demographic data element collected once per patient.

label: Traumatic Coma Databank (TCDB) Classification
definition: A standardized classification system for CT scan abnormalities in traumatic brain injury patients.

label: Machine
definition: A medical device or instrument platform that contains sensors for recording patient observations.

label: Injury Variables
definition: Clinical data elements describing the nature and circumstances of the head injury.

label: Exploratory Analysis
definition: Preliminary data analysis conducted for hypothesis generation that may not meet publication standards but informs research direction.

label: Inter-Species Difference
definition: Variations in biological response and injury mechanisms between different animal species and humans.

label: Bed Tilt
definition: The angular positioning of a patient's bed relative to horizontal, which affects hydrostatic pressure gradients in physiological monitoring.

label: Study Design
definition: The overall plan and methodology for conducting a research study, including participant selection and data collection procedures.

label: Cistern State
definition: CT scan finding documenting the status of brain cisterns, classified as present, compressed, or absent.

label: Data Sampling Rate
definition: The temporal frequency at which physiological data is collected, critical for detecting short-duration secondary insults.

label: Computed Tomography (CT) Scan
definition: Neuroimaging data collected at admission and worst CT scan, classified using Traumatic Coma Databank nomenclature to identify lesion type and volume.

label: Bolus Delivery
definition: A method of non-continuous drug delivery for secondary insult therapy.

label: Endotracheal Tube Suction
definition: Routine nursing intervention for suctioning the endotracheal tube, annotated as part of intensive care management information.

label: Admission Data
definition: Clinical information collected at the time of patient admission to the intensive care unit.

label: Measurement Capability
definition: The technical specifications and performance characteristics of a sensor's ability to measure a parameter.

label: Acceptable Range
definition: The valid range of values for a physiological parameter, used to identify out-of-range errors in monitoring data.

label: Semantic Accuracy
definition: A data quality dimension assessing whether data values are meaningful and correct within the medical domain.

label: Rs232/ad Interface
definition: A monitoring system type that uses RS232 or analog-to-digital interface for data transmission.

label: End-Tidal Carbon Dioxide
definition: End-tidal carbon dioxide concentration, an additional monitoring variable reflecting ventilation adequacy when monitored as part of usual clinical management.

label: Interview Method
definition: The method used to obtain GOSe outcome information, including direct interview, telephone interview, postal questionnaire, or GP contact.

label: Reading
definition: A recorded measurement of a parameter value at a specific timepoint, linked to the sensor or machine that produced it.

label: Confounding Factor
definition: A variable that influences the outcome of a clinical trial and may obscure the true effect of the intervention being studied.

label: Associated Injuries
definition: Injuries to body parts other than the head documented in patient medical history.

label: Reporting Standards
definition: Standardized formats and procedures for presenting clinical monitoring data and research findings.

label: Networked Solution
definition: A monitoring system type that uses networked connectivity to transmit data.

label: Respondent
definition: The person providing outcome information in the GOSe assessment, classified as patient, relative/carer, or both.

label: American Guidelines
definition: Published clinical guidelines for the management of traumatic brain injury, including recommendations on CPP management.

label: Age
definition: Patient age recorded as an absolute decimal number calculated from date of birth and date of injury.
